intent: Overlapping row of kit Avatars with an optional leftover count.
useWhen: Which mark: AvatarGroup is several people. One person is an Avatar; a number of items is a Count.
several people on a row, card, or table cell

size.note: Same scale as Avatar: xs 20, sm 24, md 32, lg 40, xl 48. Breaking: sm, md and lg were 32, 40 and 48.

max.note: how many Avatars to show before +N. If items.length <= max, no count.

requirements: leftover count is role=img with aria-label like "3 more"
each Avatar has a surface.card ring so faces stay apart on any ground

doNot: Do not invent a local avatar stack
Do not put a status badge on faces
Do not make the group a button
snippet: <AvatarGroup size="md" max={3} ariaLabel="Assignees" items={[{ name: "Boris Jovanovic" }, { name: "Ada Jones" }, { name: "Mira" }, { name: "Leo" }]} />
